nom: Weleda Skin Food Travel Size - 0.34 fl oz

avis.titre: Weleda is fantastic for adult acne, post peels, and contact allergies
avis.texte: How have I lived without this stuff? I have adult acne and very sensitive skin. I'm allergic to sulfates and coco betaine, among many other chemicals commonly found in cosmetics and soaps. I've been tortured the last year purchasing oodles of creams and soaps to find something that I'm not allergic to. Finally something deserving the name "natural". This stuff is PERFECT! After using it for more than a week, paired with the Weleda cold cream for my eye makeup and almond cleansing lotion, my skin is finally clear. No more soap for my face! My skin no longer flakes, breaks out, or has redness. I can put it on my eyes in the morning and put makeup on top of it, no creasing. I'm in love. I now use it before bedtime for my middle aged skin on my eyes especially (no irritation or burning on my eyes), as well as the rest of my face. People with allergies, irritated skin, post laser or other peels, this is for you. Your skin will definitely thank you for it. No burning, no peeling, no irritation at all. When you first open the bottle, you'll see what looks more like an ointment, but if you squeeze the tube just a tiny bit more you'll see the cream. The cream is very thick, and goes a very long way. When I don't use the creams on my face, or want a break from the lotions, I use micellular water as a toner.

avis.titre: Best face cream of my life
avis.texte: This is tinier than I thought, but perfect for my purse. This stuff is magic. It smells a bit strong, probably because of the lanolin, but I will never pay for luxury moisturizer again. I’m 45 and since I’ve been using this on my face (normal skin), the difference is really noticeable: when I put it on at night, my skin looks fresh and plump when I wake up in the morning. The label says this is for elbows and feet or dry, rough skin. They are crazy not to market this as a decadent face cream! I have one in the bathroom for my face, one by my bed for my feet, and another in my purse for my hands. THE BEST.

This stuff is legit! I have severely dry skin, so I use this even on my face. Smells good (my daughter said to me just this morning after I applied it, "You smell like oranges!"), and moisturizes beautifully! It does sit greasy for a bit, but once it soaks in, my skin feels insanely soft! And I haven't had any issues with it messing with my primer or makeup. I bought the full size, and a tiny travel size for my purse!

avis.titre: great moisturizer, love the travel size but its obv not a good value just convenient
avis.texte: i got this travel size because i really like weleda skin food but wanted a small size for my gym bag. the size of this tube is perfect for travel, and i'm glad its still metal (seems like weleda has switched to plastic tubes recently, at least for full sizes). skin food is great for winder dry skin, especially on hands and around the nostrils. i also use it as a lip balm and in the outer corners of my eyes. it has calendula and some beeswax, so its soothing and it stays in place. it is a heavy moisturizer, and initially will leave a greasy residue but it does absorb withing a couple minutes.

I've used other Weleda products before. I thought this was going to be similar to their oil products. This was actually a thick cream. My face is very dry and it drank this cream up. I found it hydrating, but because the cream was so thick I felt I needed to put more on to spread. Despite needing a lot of it, it wasn't greasy feeling. It has a slight, but pleasant odor.

avis.titre: Perfect Thick Moisturizer - Great for Winter!
avis.texte: A little goes such a long way - Luxurious and ultra moisturizing!
Did buy this to test the product-- but it was very small for the price and not really enough to get a clear idea how well it works. But it was recommended by my aesthetician.

A holy grail product for a reason! Seeing how people complained about how thick it is, I was planning to only use it around my eyes since that is the area where I need hydration the most. I decided on a whim to use it on my entire face before I went to bed and to my surprise it was anything but heavy. I woke up with beautifully plump and radiant skin. I am saving this for my upcoming plane trip and will repurchase a full size in the near future for sure! PS: I have dry and sensitive skin during winter and combination during those short summer months in Montreal. I cannot stand heavy creams, they make me feel like my skin is suffocating. I apply The Ordinary Marine Hyaluronics before using the Weleda cream. It goes on smoother if you use a light serum first.

Wow! Been having really bad dry skin and chapped cheeks the last few weeks. Put this on after my shower and my skin instantly felt better! Dry patches are gone. Cant wait to try this under my makeup, it's going to look flawless !

avis.titre: not worth it. just buy the normal size.
avis.texte: small and compact but I feel like it's not worth the money. if you're buying this as a tester - don't - just buy the original size and if you don't like it, use it as a hand-lotion or something.

avis.titre: Very small tube, but great product
avis.texte: The moisturizer is amazing; smooth, absorbs rapidly, and with a pleasing scent that isn't overwhelming. Word to the wise, buy the full size product. The travel size is minuscule. The full size is a much better value for your money.

Weleda products are outstanding period!!! I have always used Skin Food - its moisturizing and healing properties are nothing less than stellar. My rating for this "Travel" size is 2 stars however, because for an added 3 dollars you can buy the 2.5 oz. Duh, no brainer! This size is WAY OVER PRICED!!!
